messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "number of tablets changes each day"
set: ["number of tablets changes each day", "number of LDL particles", "take same way each day", "number of LDL receptors on liver cells", "take at same time each day", "eight 50 mg tablets a day", "8 mg orally 1 to 2 hours before each fraction of radiotherapy administered each day", "correct amount of medicine in each spray cannot be assured after the labeled number of sprays has been used", "1 mg for each kilogram of body weight once a day", "avoid drinking more than 1.2 liters of grapefruit juice each day", "Tonmya sublingual tablets taken once a day", "each brand", "each trimester", "taken at approximately the same time each day", "take at around the same time each day", "can be taken any time of the day but take at the same time each day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
